claim_tested: Is the GAMEN glutamate required for aminopeptidase catalysis?
key_finding: Aminopeptidase A Glu352 to Asp/Gly/Gln/Arg: Km unchanged, kcat down 10-250 fold, cleavage efficiency down 10/30/260/400 fold
context: Mouse APA, recombinant enzyme, synthetic substrate alpha-L-glutamyl beta-naphthylamide
confidence_and_limitations: High. Direct kinetics on the exact homologous residue. Limitation: APA not AOPEP; AOPEP carries Ala, not tested in that panel

claim_tested: Does AOPEP hydrolyse peptides as an aminopeptidase?
key_finding: Sole enzymology report for AOPEP. Retracted, J Biol Chem 2019;294(4):1433, doi:10.1074/jbc.W118.007327
confidence_and_limitations: None. Retracted; cannot be used as evidence. Any annotation tracing to it needs removal

claim_tested: Does AOPEP retain the GAMEN exopeptidase motif?
key_finding: AOPEP loop 6-mer GMASPH; 11/12 human M1 peptidases have the motif Glu, AOPEP 0/1; MEN tripeptide absent from the whole 45 aa loop; 0/161 metazoan orthologs carry Glu at the equivalent position
context: Human UniProt sequences plus 161 ortholog organisms
confidence_and_limitations: High for the sequence fact. Register independently validated by structural superposition

claim_tested: Is the zinc site geometrically assembled?
key_finding: AOPEP HEIAH479 + Glu502 superposes on bestatin-bound LTA4H (1HS6, 485 CA, RMSD 1.64 A) and ERAP1 (3MDJ, 419 CA, RMSD 1.74 A); H479 NE2 2.54/2.99 A, H483 NE2 1.25/1.46 A, E502 OE2 2.57/2.15 A, E480 OE2 4.73/5.15 A, Y586 OH 4.81/4.52 A from template zinc ligands
context: AlphaFold model AF-Q8N6M6 v6 vs two crystal structures
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate-high. Two independent templates agree. Limitation: apo prediction, no zinc modelled, side-chain rotamers unvalidated

claim_tested: Do S1 pocket residues predict a P1 preference?
key_finding: 12/25 pocket positions identical; every identical one is catalytic machinery, every substituted one is a specificity determinant (E271/E320 to A454, T350 to R476, Y267/G317 to S450, G268 to L451, Q136/E183 to S274)
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Pocket shell defined by distance to inhibitor atoms, approximate. Conclusion is negative and therefore not sensitive to shell definition

claim_tested: Is an alternative acidic anchor present?
key_finding: Arg476 (pLDDT 98.0, Arg in 160/161 orthologs) overlaps bound bestatin volume (NH1 to C14 0.84 A, CZ to C13 1.04 A in 1HS6 frame; reproduced in 3MDJ). No AOPEP Asp/Glu carboxylate other than zinc-site residues within 9 A of the bestatin N1 position
context: AlphaFold model vs two crystal structures
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Rotamer from an apo prediction; the backbone-level claim (bulky Arg where active enzymes have Val/Thr) is rotamer-independent

key_finding: Biallelic AOPEP loss-of-function causes autosomal recessive dystonia (DYT31 / Zech-Boesch syndrome)
confidence_and_limitations: High for the gene-disease link. Does not address catalysis

key_finding: 8/8 alleles match canonical 819 aa numbering; 6/8 truncate N-terminal to His479 and delete the zinc site; missense alleles A212D, G216R, R401W sit 40.8, 44.6 and 21.4 A from the zinc-ligand centroid; no allele touches a zinc ligand, Glu480 or Tyr586
context: Human alleles mapped to AF-Q8N6M6 v6
confidence_and_limitations: High. Distances are direct measurements. Allele list limited to published cases

claim_tested: Which isoforms contain the catalytic region?
key_finding: Isoforms 2 and 4 delete residues 455-553, removing the whole HEIAH-(X18)-E site; isoform 3 truncates after 554; isoform 3 cytoplasmic, canonical nucleus/nucleolus by ECO:0000250 from mouse Q8BXQ6; nucleolar localization signal 689-699
confidence_and_limitations: Low-moderate. Localization is similarity-inferred, not experimental in human
